origin: it should NOT report violation when piping 0-arity function and such functions allowed
source:
defmodule OtherModule do
  def foo, do: nil
  def bar(nil), do: nil
end

defmodule CredoSampleModule do
  def test do
    OtherModule.foo() |> bar()
    foo() |> OtherModule.bar()
    foo() |> bar()

    foo_anonymous = fn ->
      nil
    end

    foo_anonymous.() |> bar()
  end

  def foo(), do: nil
  def bar(nil), do: nil
end
